source_refs.note: Topic printed 1.1.1.1 Function Parameters and Return Values (PDF 46-47, printed 43-44); print slip for 2.5.1.2.

blocks.text: Functions can take multiple parameters and return values.
Example: Define a function to add two numbers.
def add (a , b) : return a + b
Explanation: In this example, the add function takes two parameters a and b, and returns their sum.

blocks.title: Did You Know?
blocks.text: You can call a function multiple times with different arguments to reuse the same code for different inputs.
